title: Chapter 125 Refugees Come To Surrender
content:
Chapter 125 Refugees Come To Surrender

[Red Flame Armor: Gold-level armor, defense power +120, damage reduction 20%, attached skill, flame shield, durability 200/200. 】

[Fire Shield, consume 50 points of mental power to condense a hand-held flame shield, which can resist a certain amount of damage. 】

Very good, Wang Shuo is about to replace his crocodile leather armor. This red flame armor complements his flame gun perfectly.

He took out the Nine Dragons Golden Pattern and put it on his head.

The superposition of various attributes made Wang Shuo full of confidence.

Duan Wenxi's eyes widened.

At this time, Wang Shuo looked like a majestic general, with unparalleled domineering power.

"Boss, you are so handsome!"

"If I were a woman, I would definitely marry you!"

"screw you."

Wang Shuo smiled from ear to ear, took out the flame gun again, and danced it a few times, feeling full of power.

After he calmed down, Wang Shuo took off his helmet.

Carrying this thing is still a bit in the way.

"Boss, there is another important prop. Didn't you see it?" Duan Wenxi added.

Wang Shuo rummaged carefully again and found a small tower-shaped prop.

[6G base station: After use, you can build territorial network information and establish village-level chat channels. 】

Wang Shuo was shocked that there was such a prop.

It's like hanging a key on your eyelids - your eyes are open.

Wang Shuo played with it carefully and then put it away.

"Next, we will start the construction of the territory."

Wang Shuo asked Duan Wenxi to call Suo Yong over.

The three of them looked at the village construction drawings and discussed together how to plan the layout and arrange manpower.

The top priority is to prioritize the construction of village-level administrative centers, residential buildings and city walls.

Wang Shuo had the "City Wall Construction Manual" and no longer looked down on the low walls before.

After several people divided the work, Duan Wenxi was responsible for leading the construction of the village administrative center, and Suo Yong was responsible for building residential buildings. After all, he had experience in this area before.

Wang Shuo is responsible for studying the construction of city walls, which can be regarded as his old profession.

The division of labor is completed and everyone takes action.

Wang Shuo began to survey the surrounding terrain.

Suddenly, several people came from a distance.

They were in ragged clothes, with only half health, and looked like they had just been through a fierce battle.

Wang Shuo stared at several people closely.

The leader of this group was a fat man in his 30s, covered in blood and stains. The cloth armor on his body was in tatters, and an ordinary knife in his hand had many gaps.

"Friend, how can I get to Wana Village?" The fat man looked at Wang Shuo warily and asked.

"Are you going to defect to Wana Village?" Wang Shuo raised his eyebrows and asked with a smile.

"Yes, our village was invaded by wild beasts. We managed to escape with great difficulty. In the [Chat Channel], we saw Wang Shuo recruiting people, so we planned to come and take a look."

Seeing Wang Shuo wearing mighty armor, Fatty did not check Wang Shuo's attributes to avoid unnecessary trouble.

"Very good, I am Wang Shuo, and this is Wana Village."

Several people glanced at the ruins in front of them in surprise.

I highly doubt that the person in front of me is a liar.

Isn't Wang Shuo's Wana Village territory number one?

Why is it so miserable?

Seeing the distrust on the faces of several people, Wang Shuo explained enthusiastically: "As you know, we have just experienced a war and the village has been torn to pieces. Now we are seizing the time to rebuild."

After speaking, Wang Shuo directly asked them to check his identity information.

This sight immediately frightened them.

The first was the level, which was as high as level 24, which made them take a step back slightly.
